title: Editor "Reparent to New Node" function creates path relative to EditorNode root node
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible - v4.4.stable.mono.official [4c311cbee]

baked csg meshes where added in 4.4

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable.mono - Windows 10 (build 19043) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7260) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-10400F CPU @ 2.90GHz (12 threads)

### Issue description

Bug doesn't break anything. Just annoying error, that shouldn't be here.

**- When opening the scene that contains "CSGBakedMeshInstance3D" the error pops up:**

### Steps to reproduce

open a scene with CSGBakedMeshInstance3D

rename any node in a scene that contains CSGBakedMeshInstance3D

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[csg-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19148018/csg-test.zip)

Update:
The problem is with MeshInstance3D
If you reparent it to a new node, it breaks skeleton node path
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b8c351d4-1b5d-4eca-82cf-8962c572d080)
